events.text: MARIB — Yemeni government forces targeted Houthi military positions in Marib with artillery, while warplanes launched an attack on the Jabal Hilan mountain range.

events.label: Armed forces drone strikes Houthi positions in Hajjah
events.text: HAJJAH — The armed forces announced that drone aircraft from the Fifth Military Region targeted Houthi fortifications, gatherings, and barracks in combat fronts across Hajjah governorate.

events.label: Clashes renew between Houthi forces and government forces in Taiz and Lahj
events.text: TAIZ — Back-and-forth clashes broke out between Houthi forces and government forces in several areas of Taiz, while fighting renewed on the Kahbub front in Lahj governorate.

events.label: Houthi health ministry reports casualties in Jawf airstrikes
events.text: AL-JAWF — The health ministry in the unrecognised Houthi administration announced that four people were killed and three others working in the telecommunications sector were injured by air strikes hitting telecommunications towers in Khabb wa al-Sha'af district in Jawf governorate.

events.label: Fierce clashes reported in Taiz fronts
events.text: TAIZ — Fierce clashes erupted between Saudi-backed forces and Ansar Allah in the fronts of Taiz as forces attempted to prevent advances towards strategic mountains.

events.label: Yemeni military reports airstrikes on Taiz and Mokha
events.text: TAIZ — Houthi supply routes and positions came under airstrikes in Taiz and Mokha, according to the Yemeni military.

events.label: Southern forces thwart Houthi night attack in Yafah
events.text: YAFA — Southern forces thwarted a large nighttime Houthi attack and infiltration attempt across the fronts of the Yafah axis, sparking intense clashes with heavy and medium weapons.

events.label: Sanaa forces advance in Taiz and Lahj amid clashes and air strikes
events.text: AL-ALQAMAH — Sanaa forces advanced in the Shamaiteen district of Taiz, seizing tabat al-Jorif and the villages of al-Makhshab, Sharira and al-Qahfa. Saudi jets launched air strikes on the vicinity of marafq al-Zikrah, al-Damnah and al-Rahidah in Taiz governorate, while clashes continued in Lahj governorate.

events.label: Saudi authorities intercept ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh
events.text: RIYADH — Saudi authorities reported shooting down a ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh on Saturday, as Houthi militants in Yemen said they carried out drone and ballistic missile attacks on the Saudi capital and Red Sea energy sites.

events.label: Saudi Arabia announces Riyadh targeted by ballistic missile
events.text: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia announced that Riyadh was subjected to a new attack by a Yemeni ballistic missile.

events.label: Coalition intercepts ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
events.text: RIYADH — The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched towards Riyadh.

events.label: Coalition intercepts ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
events.text: RIYADH — The coalition intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched towards Riyadh.

events.label: Yemeni forces clash with Houthi fighters in Taiz
events.text: AL-WAZI'IYAH — Yemeni government forces clashed with Houthi fighters and recaptured Jabal Naman in the Al-Wazi'iyah district of Taiz governorate.

events.label: Saudi air defences intercept Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
events.text: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia confirmed that air defences intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh. The Saudi-led coalition added that Houthi attacks targeting civilian infrastructure in Yanbu, Taif, Baysh, and Farasan were also thwarted.

events.label: Fierce clashes erupt in Lahj as Houthi forces push toward Bab al-Mandab
events.text: KAHBUB — Houthi forces deployed reinforcements toward Kahbub in Lahj governorate, Ras al-Ara, and Kharaz, where they clashed with the Southern Giants Brigades and Nation Shield forces.

events.label: Yemeni government forces clash with Houthi fighters in Hodeidah and Dhale
events.text: HODEIDAH — Yemeni government forces engaged in clashes with Houthi fighters across the Hodeidah and Dhale fronts, while also responding to sudden attacks and armed Houthi movements in central and northern fronts.

events.label: US warns of rapid Middle East escalation after Houthi missile attack on Riyadh
events.text: RIYADH — The United States warned that hostilities could escalate rapidly after a missile attack targeted Riyadh, causing a fire in a fuel tank near the airport. The White House gave no explanation for President Donald Trump cutting short a weekend at Camp David.

events.label: Heavy battles rage between Taiz and Lahj amid Houthi escalation
events.text: SHARIRAH — Intense battles broke out overnight on the Sharira and Mount Naman fronts located between Taiz and Lahj governorates, amid ongoing clashes between Yemeni government forces and Houthi forces.

events.label: Yemeni armed forces announce interception of Houthi drone in Al-Jawf
events.text: AL-JAWF — The armed forces announced the downing of an explosives-laden Houthi drone in Al-Jawf.

events.label: Yemeni army carries out air strikes against Houthi positions in Taiz and Mokha
events.text: TAIZ — The Yemeni army launched air strikes on various Houthi areas in the fronts of Taiz and Mokha, inflicting casualties.

events.label: Clashes continue across fronts as Yemeni army thwarts Houthi advance
events.text: TAIZ — Fighting continued between Yemeni government forces and the Houthis in Taiz, Lahj, and Marib, while the Yemeni army thwarted a Houthi advance attempt in Kahbub in Lahj governorate, near Bab al-Mandab.

events.label: Armed forces fend off Houthi attack in southern Marib
events.text: MARIB — The armed forces repelled a Houthi attack in the southern front of Marib.

events.label: Renewed clashes reported in western Taiz
events.text: TAIZ — Violent clashes renewed on the Al-Aghabarah front in western Taiz.

events.label: Yemeni army takes control of areas in Lahj following fierce battles
events.text: LAHJ — The Yemeni army seized control of areas in Lahj after fierce battles with the Houthis.

events.label: Yemeni army takes control of areas in Lahj after fierce battles
events.text: LAHJ — The Yemeni army seized control of areas in Lahj following fierce battles with the Houthis.

events.label: Saudi Arabia issues second wave of warnings over potential attacks
events.text: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia issued warnings for the second time regarding attacks targeting Riyadh and Al-Kharj.

events.label: Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh
events.text: RIYADH — Residents in Saudi Arabia's Riyadh received the all-clear after air raid alerts were issued and explosions were reported in the capital. It was the first time alerts have been issued in Riyadh since the Houthis increased their attacks.

events.label: Saudi Civil Defense issues threat alert in Riyadh and Al-Kharj
events.text: RIYADH — The Saudi Civil Defense announced a threat alert in Riyadh and Al-Kharj following operations targeting Yanbu, Al-Ula, Jeddah, and Jizan on the kingdom's western coast.

events.label: Yemeni armed forces recapture positions in Taiz and Lahj
events.text: AL-WAZI'IYAH — Yemeni armed forces recaptured positions including Mount al-Shuhada in the al-Wazi'iyah front southwest of Taiz following a counterattack. The forces also targeted Houthi positions and repelled infiltration attempts in Marib and Lahj.

events.label: Yemeni army air strikes target Houthi positions in Taiz
events.text: TAIZ — Military warplanes of the army launched air strikes on Houthi positions and gatherings around the Palace Roundabout east of Taiz.

events.label: Houthi drone strike kills three children in Taiz
events.text: AL-WAZI'IYAH — A Houthi drone strike targeted the village of Al-Tarirah in Al-Wazi'iyah district, killing three children and injuring others.

events.label: Fierce clashes and air strikes leave casualties in Al-Wazi'iyah
events.text: AL-WAZI'IYAH — Clashes and air strikes targeting Houthi forces in Al-Wazi'iyah district west of Taiz resulted in 90 casualties.

events.label: Yemeni warplanes target Houthi reinforcements on Al-Barh road
events.text: AL-BARH — Yemeni military warplanes carried out intensive air strikes targeting Houthi reinforcements and gatherings along the Al-Barh - Al-Wazi'iyah road.

events.label: Saree: Saudi jets launched 37 air strikes over 24 hours
events.text: TAIZ — Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree stated that Saudi warplanes carried out 37 F-15 air strikes taking off from Khamis Mushait Air Base against Taiz and Hajjah governorates.

events.label: Houthi drone shrapnel kills one and injures two in Taif
events.text: TAIF — Shrapnel from a Houthi drone intercepted and destroyed over Taif in western Saudi Arabia killed a Yemeni resident and injured a Saudi citizen and a Pakistani resident.

events.label: Saree: Saudi warplanes carried out 40 air raids in 24 hours
events.text: TAIZ — Yahya Saree stated that Saudi warplanes using F-15 aircraft taking off from Khamis Mushait base carried out 40 air raids over 24 hours targeting the Taiz, Marib, and Hajjah governorates.

events.label: Clashes and strikes in Taiz leave over 90 Houthi dead or wounded
events.text: AL-WAZI'IYAH — Clashes and air strikes in the Al-Waziyah district of Taiz resulted in 30 Houthi fighters killed and over 60 others injured, according to a military source. The operations also destroyed six combat vehicles and two tanks.

events.label: Yemeni armed forces target Houthi gatherings in Marib with drones
events.text: MARIB — The Yemeni armed forces carried out drone attacks targeting Houthi gatherings in the northern fronts of Marib. Meanwhile, artillery units destroyed nine Houthi combat vehicles in the western fronts.

events.label: Yemeni government forces repel Houthi attack and advance in Taiz
events.text: TAIZ — Yemeni government forces repelled a Houthi attack in the Kadha front west of Taiz and recaptured positions in Jabal al-Shuhada in the Al-Waziyah district.

events.label: Yemeni army recaptures positions and shoots down drone in Taiz
events.text: TAIZ — Yemeni army forces recaptured positions in the Kadha area of Al-Ma'afir district and the Al-Waziyah district in Taiz following clashes with Houthi forces, while also shooting down a drone.

events.label: Houthi explosive drone hits government position on Al-Had front in Yafa, killing a soldier
events.text: YAFA — The drone struck an advanced position on the Al-Had front in Yafa district, bordering Al-Bayda, killing one soldier and wounding two, military sources said.

events.label: Houthi attack on the Al-Azariq–Tursa front west of Al-Dhale repelled
events.text: AL-AZARIQ — Houthi forces attacked government positions under heavy-weapons fire; government forces repelled the attack after clashes, military sources said.

events.label: Houthi security force and tribesmen clash in Khamir, Amran; two Houthi members killed
events.text: KHAMIR — Fighting broke out when a Houthi patrol tried to detain members of a family backing a tribal mobilisation against the group; two Houthi members were killed and two wounded, local sources said.

events.label: Air strikes hit the runways at Sanaa airport to stop an Iranian aircraft landing
events.text: SANAA AIRPORT — Yemen's government defence ministry said its forces struck the runway to prevent an Iranian aircraft from landing; the Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia, called it the end of de-escalation and vowed to respond.

events.label: Strike destroys the runway at Hodeidah airport, sources say
events.text: HODEIDAH AIRPORT — The strike came hours after the government said it had struck Sanaa airport's runway; the Iranian aircraft then landed at Hodeidah and later left.

events.label: Houthi missile launched towards Saudi Arabia falls in Saada, sources say
events.text: SAADA — Houthi missile launched towards Saudi Arabia falls in Saada, sources say.

events.label: Houthi ballistic missiles and drones target Abha airport; coalition says it intercepted ballistic missiles
events.text: ABHA AIRPORT — Explosions were heard around Abha and air traffic was halted; Houthi-aligned channels reported a missile falling at King Khalid Air Base. The Houthi military said the attack answered the strike on Sanaa airport.

events.label: Sirens and explosions reported in Jeddah
events.text: JEDDAH — Sirens and explosions reported in Jeddah.

events.label: Air strikes hit mountain caves in Saada described as shelters of the Houthi leader, local sources say
events.text: SAADA — Several strikes hit mountain areas including caves used as shelters; explosions were heard around Saada.

events.label: Houthis say they shot down a Saudi Wing Loong II drone over Al-Bayda
events.text: AL-BAYDA — Houthis say they shot down a Saudi Wing Loong II drone over Al-Bayda.

events.label: Houthi media: government shelling on Subayra in Qataba, Al-Dhale, badly wounds a child
events.text: QATABA — Houthi media: government shelling on Subayra in Qataba, Al-Dhale, badly wounds a child.

events.label: Houthi mortar fire hits joint forces' positions on the Al-Thawkhab front north of Al-Dhale
events.text: AL-THAWKHAB — Eight mortar rounds landed around forward positions, a military source said.

events.label: Unidentified large drone crashes in Wadi Bayhan, Shabwa
events.text: BAYHAN — Unidentified large drone crashes in Wadi Bayhan, Shabwa.

events.label: Houthi attack on the Qanaw front east of Al-Jawf repelled, army says
events.text: QANAW — The army said the attack on its positions was repelled with heavy Houthi losses.

events.label: Houthi media: Saudi artillery shells Bani Sayyah in Razih district, Saada, damaging farms
events.text: RAZIH — Houthi media: Saudi artillery shells Bani Sayyah in Razih district, Saada, damaging farms.

events.label: Houthi drone falls near homes in Nati, Al-Bayda, without exploding
events.text: NATI — Houthi drone falls near homes in Nati, Al-Bayda, without exploding.

events.label: Houthi assault on Qanaw, east of Al-Hazm near the tribal Nakf al-Karama camp, repelled
events.text: QANAW — Government forces said they repelled a large Houthi attack on Qanaw, east of Bir al-Marazeeq, the front line closest to the tribal camp at Al-Rayyan; attackers were killed and wounded, field sources said.

events.label: Clashes on the Kalaba front north-east of Taiz city; a government soldier killed
events.text: KALABA — Clashes on the Kalaba front north-east of Taiz city; a government soldier killed.

events.label: Houthi attack on the Bab Ghalaq and Al-Fakhir fronts in Qataba repelled; three government soldiers killed
events.text: AL-FAKHIR — Government forces repelled the attack after clashes with medium and heavy weapons and shelling, field sources said.

events.label: Heavy explosions heard in Sanaa at dawn, mostly around the airport
events.text: SANAA — The blasts were concentrated around Sanaa airport in the north of the city, residents said.

events.label: National Resistance forces repel a Houthi night infiltration on the southern Hodeidah front
events.text: HAYS — The forces said they engaged Houthi fighters clearing their own minefield in front of the 13th Infantry Brigade's sector and forced them back with casualties.

events.label: Houthi drone strike on a house in Hays kills a 70-year-old man
events.text: HAYS — Suleiman al-Haymi was wounded when the drone hit his home in Bayt al-Haymi village and died later at a field hospital in Al-Khokha, local sources said.

events.label: Houthi mortar fire on the Thirah front between Abyan and Al-Bayda; government forces return fire
events.text: THIRAH — Houthi mortar fire on the Thirah front between Abyan and Al-Bayda; government forces return fire.

events.label: Failed Houthi ballistic missile launch sets off heavy explosions near Al-Hazm, sources say
events.text: AL-HAZM — Local sources said the missile blew up on its launcher in farmland in Al-Hazm district, killing members of the launch crew, including Hezbollah experts.

events.label: Houthi sniper kills a civilian in Sabir al-Mawadim, south of Taiz city
events.text: SABIR AL-MAWADIM — The 26-year-old was shot in Suraybit village, the interior ministry's media said.

events.label: National Resistance forces repel a Houthi advance on Jabal Dubas, south of Hodeidah
events.text: JABAL DUBAS — National Resistance forces repel a Houthi advance on Jabal Dubas, south of Hodeidah.

events.label: National Resistance navy turns back armed Houthi boats approaching Zuqar island
events.text: ZUQAR ISLAND — The boats came from the direction of the shipping lane and withdrew north towards Al-Fazah, the forces said.

events.label: Explosion heard in Dhamar's Jabal al-Sharq, reportedly air-defence fire
events.text: DHAMAR — Explosion heard in Dhamar's Jabal al-Sharq, reportedly air-defence fire.

events.label: Houthi missile falls on a farm in Al-Jawf, video shows
events.text: AL-JAWF — Houthi missile falls on a farm in Al-Jawf, video shows.

events.label: Houthi drone strike on an army position in Harib, Marib, kills four soldiers
events.text: HARIB — Houthi drone strike on an army position in Harib, Marib, kills four soldiers.

events.label: Government forces take strategic heights overlooking Harib and Al-Abdiyah after overnight fighting
events.text: HARIB — Heavy clashes broke out on the Harib front south of Marib overnight; Saba axis forces and Giants Brigades reinforcements then counter-attacked, and military sources said Houthi fighters withdrew with heavy losses.

events.label: Houthi shelling on villages in north-western Qataba, Al-Dhale, seriously wounds a civilian
events.text: QATABA — Shells hit Shakhb, the Al-Zubayriyat market and farms in Bilad al-Yubi, local sources said.

events.label: Southern forces repel Houthi attacks on the Al-Thawkhab and Bab Ghalaq fronts in Al-Dhale; three soldiers killed
events.text: AL-THAWKHAB — Government forces answered with rocket launchers, artillery and armour, field sources said.

events.label: Houthis attack Saudi oil tankers ENCELIA and LAYLA in the Red Sea; ENCELIA on fire 70 nautical miles off Al-Shuqaiq
events.text: RED SEA OFF AL-SHUQAIQ — The Houthi military said it fired ballistic missiles and drones at the two tankers for breaking its ban; UKMTO said a tanker master reported an attack 70 nautical miles from Al-Shuqaiq, and ENCELIA radioed for help after a fire broke out on board, Reuters reported.

events.label: Houthi assault on the Al-Fakhir, Al-Jubb and Al-Thawkhab fronts in Al-Dhale repelled; four soldiers and 23 Houthi fighters killed
events.text: AL-THAWKHAB — Ten soldiers were wounded in the dawn attack, which was backed by drones and mortar fire, the Al-Dhale axis media centre said.

events.label: Tribesmen and Houthi forces clash in Barat, Al-Jawf; three tribesmen and four Houthi fighters killed
events.text: BARAT — The fighting began when a Houthi force moved against a house in Al-Salil over a land dispute; tribesmen burned several Houthi vehicles, tribal sources said.

events.label: Houthi artillery and rocket fire hits homes in the 7 July neighbourhood of Taiz city
events.text: TAIZ — Houthi artillery and rocket fire hits homes in the 7 July neighbourhood of Taiz city.

events.label: Coast guard shoots down a Houthi reconnaissance drone over Abu Zahr, south of Hodeidah
events.text: ABU ZAHR — Coast guard shoots down a Houthi reconnaissance drone over Abu Zahr, south of Hodeidah.

events.label: Houthis attack Saudi ship NCC MASA in the Red Sea; Saudi authorities report light damage
events.text: RED SEA NEAR BAB AL-MANDAB — The Saudi transport authority said the vessel suffered minor damage.

events.label: Coalition air strikes hit Houthi sites in Hodeidah, including telecommunications facilities, after the tanker attack
events.text: HODEIDAH — Houthi media said a series of raids hit facilities of the telecommunications corporation and that air defences fired at the aircraft; the coalition said it struck military sites, and Saudi media said the port was not hit.
events.source: Al-Masirah · Ali Bk · Sabereen News · Almashhad

events.label: Air strikes hit Kamaran island, wounding a woman, Houthi media say
events.text: KAMARAN — Air strikes hit Kamaran island, wounding a woman, Houthi media say.

events.label: Houthi ballistic missiles and drones hit Aramco facilities in Jazan; large fires in the industrial area
events.text: JAZAN — The Houthi military said it fired dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Aramco sites in Jazan; residents filmed fires and smoke, and satellite images later showed burning storage tanks. Saudi civil defence sounded early warnings in Jazan.
events.source: Naya · Ali Bk · Al-Masirah · Almashhad · Al-Mihwar

events.label: Houthi missiles and drones target Aramco in Yanbu; two ballistic missiles intercepted, Reuters says
events.text: YANBU — A Greek-operated air-defence system intercepted two ballistic missiles aimed at Yanbu's refineries, Greek security sources told Reuters; Saudi civil defence sounded early warnings in Yanbu three times.

events.label: Explosions reported at Khamis Mushait air base during the Houthi missile attack
events.text: KHAMIS MUSHAIT — Explosions reported at Khamis Mushait air base during the Houthi missile attack.

events.label: Government jets strike Houthi missile launchers and arms depots in Al-Jubah and Majzar, Marib
events.text: AL-JUBAH — State television said the strikes hit rocket launch pads, a Katyusha launch base and weapons stores in Al-Jubah, Al-Safra and Majzar, killing Houthi fighters including missile experts.

events.label: Government air strikes hit Houthi launch sites and weapons stores in Al-Jawf
events.text: AL-JAWF — Government air strikes hit Houthi launch sites and weapons stores in Al-Jawf.

events.label: Houthis fire two missiles from Al-Hawban, east of Taiz, towards the Red Sea, local sources say
events.text: AL-HAWBAN — Houthis fire two missiles from Al-Hawban, east of Taiz, towards the Red Sea, local sources say.

events.label: Houthi shelling hits the judicial complex and homes around Jabal Jarrah in central Taiz
events.text: TAIZ — Mortar and artillery rounds fell on the judicial complex and on residential areas around Jabal Jarrah, local sources said.

events.label: Government jets strike Houthi sites in Kawlat al-Qadi and Al-Shaab in Damt, Al-Dhale
events.text: DAMT — Military sources said the targets were used to store weapons and gather fighters.

events.label: Heavy clashes on the Al-Jawf front, Houthi-aligned media say
events.text: AL-JAWF — Heavy clashes on the Al-Jawf front, Houthi-aligned media say.

events.label: Houthi checkpoint gunmen kill three Al Ju'aid tribesmen in Khab wa al-Sha'af, Al-Jawf
events.text: KHAB WA AL-SHAAF — Two tribesmen were wounded and limited clashes followed at Houthi checkpoints, hours after two Houthi fighters were killed at another checkpoint in the district, local sources said.

events.label: Tribesmen and government forces fight Houthi forces in Al-Jawf; 20 Houthi fighters captured, tribal sources say
events.text: AL-JAWF — The Houthis sent reinforcements from Arhab, north of Sanaa, the sources said.

events.label: Dhu Husayn tribesmen attack Houthi checkpoints at the Al-Yatamah market in Al-Jawf
events.text: YATMAH — Clashes went on into a second day across several areas of Al-Jawf; on 27 July an attack on a Houthi checkpoint on the Al-Sha'af road killed a Houthi fighter, local sources said.

events.label: Heavy clashes on the Al-Dhale front; joint forces report taking several positions
events.text: AL-DHALE — Heavy clashes on the Al-Dhale front; joint forces report taking several positions.

events.label: Projectile lands very close to a tanker in the southern Red Sea, UKMTO says
events.text: SOUTHERN RED SEA — The tanker and its crew were reported safe.

events.label: Unknown projectile hits a tanker in the southern Red Sea, causing damage, UKMTO says
events.text: SOUTHERN RED SEA — Unknown projectile hits a tanker in the southern Red Sea, causing damage, UKMTO says.

events.label: Houthis say they shot down a Bayraktar Akinci drone over Al-Jawf
events.text: AL-JAWF — The Houthi military released footage of the wreckage.

events.label: Air strike in Al-Jawf seriously wounds a senior Houthi commander
events.text: AL-HAZM — Hussein al-Nimri, the Houthis' central security commander for Amran, was wounded at a military site in Al-Jawf, sources said.

events.label: Air strike hits a Houthi operations centre on Kamaran island, killing foreign military experts, sources say
events.text: KAMARAN — Military sources told Sheba Intelligence the strike on a command facility used for Houthi naval operations killed and wounded Iranian and Iraqi advisers.

events.label: Drones attack Aramco's Abqaiq plant; Saudi Arabia says they came from Iraq, the Houthis claim the attack
events.text: ABQAIQ — The Saudi defence ministry said it intercepted and destroyed several drones aimed at oil facilities; the Houthi military said it hit crude supply points between the east and Yanbu, and Iraqi armed groups claimed attacks on oil sites in Riyadh and the Eastern Province. Satellite images showed damage at the Abqaiq processing plant.

events.label: Houthi media: government sniper wounds a girl in Qataba, Al-Dhale
events.text: QATABA — Houthi media: government sniper wounds a girl in Qataba, Al-Dhale.

events.label: Government artillery pounds Houthi positions north and west of Al-Dhale
events.text: AL-DHALE — Government artillery pounds Houthi positions north and west of Al-Dhale.

events.label: Gunmen kill a Houthi intelligence officer in an ambush near Sanaa airport
events.text: SANAA AIRPORT — Abu Hussein al-Arhabi and a companion were shot in a taxi near the Mus'ab roundabout; brief clashes followed with his escorts, sources said.

events.label: Explosions heard in northern Sanaa at dawn; residents suspect missile launches towards Saudi Arabia
events.text: SANAA — Explosions heard in northern Sanaa at dawn; residents suspect missile launches towards Saudi Arabia.

events.label: Joint forces say artillery and rocket fire destroyed a Houthi missile and ammunition depot at Hubayl al-Sama'i, north of Qataba
events.text: QATABA — Houthi reinforcements at Naqil al-Khashabah, on the supply road to Ibb, were also hit, the Al-Dhale axis media centre said.

events.label: Houthis fire ballistic missiles at Saudi tanker NCC GHAZAL off Jazan; the Houthi military says the ship turned back
events.text: RED SEA OFF JAZAN — Houthis fire ballistic missiles at Saudi tanker NCC GHAZAL off Jazan; the Houthi military says the ship turned back.

events.label: Houthi drone strike wounds two Shabwa Defence soldiers on the Harib front
events.text: HARIB — Houthi drone strike wounds two Shabwa Defence soldiers on the Harib front.

events.label: Explosion near a merchant ship off Jazan after Houthi missile launches from the hills east of Haradh
events.text: RED SEA OFF JAZAN — Residents saw several missiles fired towards the sea from the mountains east of Haradh; UKMTO later said a ship reported an explosion nearby, with no damage or injuries.

events.label: Houthis say they shot down a Saudi Karayel reconnaissance drone over Saada
events.text: SAADA — Houthis say they shot down a Saudi Karayel reconnaissance drone over Saada.

events.label: Houthi drone hits Al-Zaytuna camp at Al-Anad in Lahj, wounding Nation's Shield troops
events.text: AL-ANAD — Houthi drone hits Al-Zaytuna camp at Al-Anad in Lahj, wounding Nation's Shield troops.

events.label: Joint forces destroy a Houthi vehicle and down a Houthi drone on the Bab Ghalaq front; Houthi mortars hit villages
events.text: AL-FAKHIR — Houthi mortar rounds damaged homes in Hajr and Al-Masharih, field sources said.

events.label: Houthi attack on the Bab Ghalaq front repelled; government artillery hits reinforcements near the Al-Fakhir triangle
events.text: AL-FAKHIR — Houthi attack on the Bab Ghalaq front repelled; government artillery hits reinforcements near the Al-Fakhir triangle.

events.label: Government air defences down a Houthi drone over Al-Maqatirah, south of Taiz
events.text: AL-MAQATIRAH — The Tur al-Bahah axis said the drone was heading for a training camp.

events.label: Government forces shoot down a Houthi explosive drone on the Al-Razamat front in Saada
events.text: AL-RAZAMAT — Government forces shoot down a Houthi explosive drone on the Al-Razamat front in Saada.

events.label: Two explosions heard in Riyadh; flights unable to land at King Khalid airport, Houthi-aligned channels say
events.text: RIYADH — Two explosions heard in Riyadh; flights unable to land at King Khalid airport, Houthi-aligned channels say.

events.label: Failed Houthi ballistic missile launch in Sanhan; the missile fell in nearby hills, residents say
events.text: SANHAN — Houthi vehicles then searched the villages of Na'd, Al-Durm and Al-Sarin for the wreckage, local sources said.

events.label: Houthi drones fly over Al-Anad air base; southern forces engage drones west of Aden
events.text: AL-ANAD — Houthi drones fly over Al-Anad air base; southern forces engage drones west of Aden.

events.label: Houthi media: government mortar fire kills a woman at Jisr al-Silw in Taiz
events.text: AL-SALW — Houthi media: government mortar fire kills a woman at Jisr al-Silw in Taiz.

events.label: Houthi mortar fire hits homes and a water facility in Al-Haymah, south of Hodeidah
events.text: AL-HAYMAH — Houthi mortar fire hits homes and a water facility in Al-Haymah, south of Hodeidah.

events.label: Houthi infiltration on the Bab Ghalaq–Hajar front repelled; artillery duels on the Murays front
events.text: AL-FAKHIR — Houthi infiltration on the Bab Ghalaq–Hajar front repelled; artillery duels on the Murays front.

events.label: Government forces repel a Houthi attack in the western countryside of Taiz
events.text: WESTERN TAIZ COUNTRYSIDE — Government forces repel a Houthi attack in the western countryside of Taiz.

events.label: Failed Houthi ballistic missile launch near Jabal Nuqum shakes Sanaa, killing five missile crew, sources say
events.text: SANAA — The missile rose and then fell back into the hill behind the Barash camp, local sources said.

events.label: Government forces repel a Houthi infiltration on the Al-Kurayfat front east of Taiz city
events.text: AL-KURAYFAT — The 22nd Mechanised Brigade said Houthi fighters were killed and vehicles destroyed.

events.label: Clashes on the Al-Unayn front in Jabal Habashi, west of Taiz; three Houthi fighters killed or wounded, Taiz axis says
events.text: AL-UNAYN — Clashes on the Al-Unayn front in Jabal Habashi, west of Taiz; three Houthi fighters killed or wounded, Taiz axis says.

events.label: Houthi sniper kills a man riding with his child in Maqbanah, west of Taiz
events.text: MAQBANAH — Houthi sniper kills a man riding with his child in Maqbanah, west of Taiz.

events.label: Joint forces shoot down a Houthi reconnaissance drone over the Al-Had front in Lahj
events.text: YAFA — Joint forces shoot down a Houthi reconnaissance drone over the Al-Had front in Lahj.

events.label: Nation's Shield brigade commander Osama al-Radfani assassinated between Al-Wadiah and Al-Abr; the government blames the Houthis
events.text: AL-ABR — Nation's Shield brigade commander Osama al-Radfani assassinated between Al-Wadiah and Al-Abr; the government blames the Houthis.

events.label: Houthi assault on Jabal Han, west of Taiz city, repelled
events.text: JABAL HAN — The hill overlooks the Al-Dabab road, the main route into Taiz city from the west, military sources said.

events.label: Houthi shelling on the Al-Fakhir front kills a soldier and wounds two; mortars hit farms in Al-Azariq
events.text: AL-FAKHIR — Houthi shelling on the Al-Fakhir front kills a soldier and wounds two; mortars hit farms in Al-Azariq.

events.label: Five Houthi fighters killed in a failed infiltration at Jabal Han, west of Taiz, army says
events.text: JABAL HAN — Five Houthi fighters killed in a failed infiltration at Jabal Han, west of Taiz, army says.

events.label: Houthi mortar fire hits homes in northern Hays
events.text: HAYS — Houthi mortar fire hits homes in northern Hays.

events.label: Government artillery hits a Houthi vehicle near the Al-Furqan school below Naqil al-Silw, south-east of Taiz
events.text: AL-SALW — Government artillery hits a Houthi vehicle near the Al-Furqan school below Naqil al-Silw, south-east of Taiz.

events.label: Government artillery hits Houthi reinforcements heading for the Murays front in Al-Dhale
events.text: MURAYS — Government artillery hits Houthi reinforcements heading for the Murays front in Al-Dhale.

events.label: Government forces launch a 'Decisive Promise' raid on Houthi positions in Al-Safra, Saada
events.text: AL-RAZAMAT — The 245th Brigade said the operation hit Houthi gatherings and barracks in Al-Safra district.

events.label: Houthis say a drone hit a 'sensitive target' at Najran airport
events.text: NAJRAN — The Houthi military said the attack answered Saudi drone flights over Saada and Hajjah.

events.label: Indian cargo ship sinks 13 nautical miles south of Hodeidah after an explosive boat attack; 14 crew rescued
events.text: RED SEA OFF HODEIDAH — Yemeni navy and coast guard units rescued the 13 Indian crew and one Yemeni; India's shipping minister said the ship was hit by a projectile.
events.source: Almashhad · Naya · Ali Bk · Sabereen News

events.label: Houthi snipers and a drone strike kill five soldiers and wound six south of Marib
events.text: HARIB — Houthi snipers and a drone strike kill five soldiers and wound six south of Marib.

events.label: Government air defences down a Houthi winged drone over Ayrim in Al-Qabbaytah, northern Lahj
events.text: AL-QABBAYTAH — Government air defences down a Houthi winged drone over Ayrim in Al-Qabbaytah, northern Lahj.

events.label: Air strikes hit Al-Dailami air base and Sarf in Sanaa, residents say
events.text: SANAA — Houthi-aligned channels said the blasts were missile launches towards Saudi Arabia.

events.label: Houthis attack Saudi tanker Wafa north of Yanbu; Lloyd's List sources confirm the attack
events.text: RED SEA OFF YANBU — Houthis attack Saudi tanker Wafa north of Yanbu; Lloyd's List sources confirm the attack.

events.label: Tribesmen clash with Houthi forces over land at Al-Jarr, east of Al-Hazm
events.text: AL-JARR — Tribesmen clash with Houthi forces over land at Al-Jarr, east of Al-Hazm.

events.label: Houthis fire a ballistic missile at Saudi tanker Daisy 95 nautical miles south-east of Aden; UKMTO reports an explosion close to a tanker
events.text: GULF OF ADEN — Houthis fire a ballistic missile at Saudi tanker Daisy 95 nautical miles south-east of Aden; UKMTO reports an explosion close to a tanker.

events.label: Gunfire as a drone flies low over the governor's palace in Mukalla
events.text: AL-MUKALLA — Gunfire as a drone flies low over the governor's palace in Mukalla.

events.label: Explosion at a Houthi missile facility west of Sanaa kills 26 missile-force members, a researcher says
events.text: AL-ZAWN — The blast hit a tunnel between Manakhah and Al-Haymah al-Kharijiyah used to assemble ballistic missiles.

events.label: Government air defences shoot down a Houthi drone over Marib city
events.text: MARIB — Government air defences shoot down a Houthi drone over Marib city.

events.label: Houthi ballistic missiles and drones hit emergency-force camps at Al-Thaniyah and Al-Ruwayk; dozens of soldiers killed
events.text: AL-RUWAYK — Military sources put the toll at 45 dead and 64 wounded; the joint operations command announced 17 dead. The Houthi military said it struck mobilisations at Al-Ruwayk, Al-Abr and Al-Thaniyah; the emergency forces' commander said 12 ballistic missiles were fired, from Al-Mahzamat in Al-Jawf.

events.label: Houthi strike on an emergency-forces camp at Al-Wadiah, Hadramawt, kills eight soldiers
events.text: AL-WADIAH — Houthi strike on an emergency-forces camp at Al-Wadiah, Hadramawt, kills eight soldiers.

events.label: Houthi drone wounds three soldiers west of Taiz
events.text: WESTERN TAIZ COUNTRYSIDE — Houthi drone wounds three soldiers west of Taiz.

events.label: Houthi drone and artillery attack on the Murays front north of Al-Dhale
events.text: MURAYS — Houthi drone and artillery attack on the Murays front north of Al-Dhale.

timeline.title: Roots of the Houthi movement
timeline.summary: In northern Yemen, around Saada, a Zaydi religious and social movement grew up around the al-Houthi family — the root of what later became the Houthis.
timeline.detail: Unified Yemen was created in 1990 from the merger of north and south. In the far northern highlands, and especially in Saada governorate on the Saudi border, Zaydi communities — a Shia tradition particular to Yemen — felt pushed aside by the centre in Sanaa. Hussein Badreddin al-Houthi led study circles and activism known as the Believing Youth: at first a religious and social identity rather than a national army. Poverty in the north, President Ali Abdullah Saleh's suspicion of the movement, and regional tensions after 2003 gradually turned it into an armed political force. This period is the foundation of today's Houthi movement.
timeline.mapNote: The focus is Saada and the northern highlands — still far from Sanaa and the coast.

timeline.title: The Saada wars
timeline.summary: Between 2004 and 2010 Yemeni government forces fought the Houthis in Saada through six rounds. Hussein al-Houthi was killed, but the movement survived and grew stronger.
timeline.detail: The first round broke out in 2004 after Saleh's government tried to detain Hussein al-Houthi. He was killed that year — and rather than dissolving the movement, his death consolidated it around his brothers and tribal allies. Six rounds of fighting followed, at times drawing in Saudi forces on the border. Neither side won outright: the Houthis learned to fight, built local networks and accumulated weapons and experience. The political wound in the north never closed, so when the state faltered in 2011 they were no longer merely local rebels.
timeline.mapNote: Fighting concentrated in and around Saada — not yet a war for all of Yemen.

timeline.title: The Arab Spring and Saleh's fall
timeline.summary: The 2011 protests weakened Saleh's rule. He was replaced by Abd Rabbu Mansour Hadi, and the Houthis used the vacuum to expand south from Saada.
timeline.detail: As in other Arab states, crowds turned out in Yemen against a long-serving ruler. Saleh was pushed into a negotiated exit brokered by the Gulf states, and the interim president, Hadi, tried to run a national dialogue and write a new constitution. In practice the army and the state split, security weakened, and groups such as al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula exploited the chaos. The Houthis, already hardened by the Saada wars, pushed south, took more ground in the north, and at times cooperated with remnants of Saleh's camp. This is the point at which they stopped being a local story and became a national actor.
timeline.mapNote: Gradual expansion south from Saada towards Sanaa.

timeline.title: The fall of Sanaa
timeline.summary: In September 2014 the Houthis took Sanaa. The government collapsed, Hadi fled, and Yemen entered full national war.
timeline.detail: After capturing Amran to the north of the capital, Houthi fighters entered Sanaa, partly backed by forces tied to Saleh, who wanted revenge on the system that removed him. They seized ministries, weapons and institutions. UN-brokered agreements did not hold. In February 2015 Hadi fled first to Aden and then to Saudi Arabia. From this point there were in effect two Yemens: a Houthi-held north-west with Sanaa as its de facto capital, and a government and southern camp reliant on outside support. That fracture line runs through to today's map.
timeline.mapNote: The north-west passes to Houthi control, with the capital in their hands.

timeline.title: The Saudi-led intervention
timeline.summary: In March 2015 a Saudi-led coalition opened an air campaign to restore Hadi's government — the start of the regional war over Yemen.
timeline.detail: Saudi Arabia and its allies feared Houthi control, seen as close to Iran, over their southern border and over sea lanes. The campaign, named Decisive Storm and then Restoring Hope, combined air strikes, a partial naval blockade and support for local forces in the south. Aden was taken back from the Houthis in 2015 and became the seat of the internationally recognised government — but Sanaa and most of the north-west stayed in Houthi hands. Instead of a quick decision, a long war of attrition opened, at very heavy civilian cost.
timeline.mapNote: The south returns to the government; the north-west stays Houthi.

timeline.title: Fixed fronts: Taiz, Marib and the south
timeline.summary: Years of relative stalemate: Taiz under partial siege, Marib a government energy stronghold, and a widening split in the south between the government and separatist forces.
timeline.detail: The front lines set. Taiz — a large city in south-western Yemen between the highlands and the coast — became a symbol of civilian suffering, with fighting, partial siege and difficult aid access. Marib in the east stayed important for its oil and gas and its government administration. In the south the Southern Transitional Council emerged, a separatist force seeking an independent or autonomous south, which at times fought Hadi's government as well as the Houthis. The anti-Houthi camp was never a single ordered bloc.
timeline.mapNote: Front lines harden; the south is politically split.

timeline.title: The Stockholm Agreement and Hodeidah
timeline.summary: In late 2018 a UN-brokered agreement covered the port of Hodeidah, to head off a major battle over Yemen's humanitarian import artery.
timeline.detail: Hodeidah is the main Red Sea port; food, fuel and aid for much of the population come through it. Coalition and government forces were closing on the port and the UN warned of humanitarian catastrophe. In December 2018, at talks in Sweden, the parties agreed a local ceasefire, a redeployment around the port and a monitoring mechanism, along with a prisoner exchange and understandings on Taiz. Implementation was partial and cumbersome — but the big battle for the port was averted. The west coast stayed fragile from then on, even as fighting continued elsewhere.
timeline.mapNote: The west coast is relatively frozen around the port — not a national peace.

timeline.title: The 2022 truce and the Presidential Council
timeline.summary: A UN-brokered truce in April 2022 slowed the fighting, and a Presidential Leadership Council replaced Hadi.
timeline.detail: The truce cut air strikes and temporarily opened routes to the ports and the airport — real relief for civilians, without ending the war. In parallel Hadi handed his powers to a Presidential Leadership Council under Rashad al-Alimi, an attempt to unify the anti-Houthi camp under a collective leadership recognised internationally as Yemen's legitimate government. The truce eroded and never became a permanent peace, but it changed the tempo: less daily escalation, until broader fighting resumed in the years that followed.
timeline.mapNote: Fighting slows, with no major change of control on the map.

timeline.title: The Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab
timeline.summary: From late 2023 the Houthis attacked shipping in the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab strait, and the US, Britain and partners answered with strikes and naval operations.
timeline.detail: After the war in Gaza began, the Houthis declared attacks on vessels they said were linked to Israel or its allies. In practice global trade routes through the Bab al-Mandab strait — the chokepoint between the Red Sea and the Arabian Sea — were disrupted. Shipping lines rerouted around Africa and freight rates rose. The US and Britain led military responses and maritime protection operations. Yemen's internal conflict connected to a regional and global front. Bab al-Mandab and the west coast are an international corridor, not only a Yemeni border.
timeline.mapNote: The focus shifts to the sea, at Bab al-Mandab and in the Red Sea.

timeline.title: Realignment in the south before the 2026 round
timeline.summary: In early 2026 a political and military reshuffle in the south narrowed the split between separatist forces and the Presidential Council, in preparation for renewed fighting in the west.
timeline.detail: Years of friction between the Southern Transitional Council and the government had weakened the ability to face the Houthis on a single front. Open-source reporting from early 2026 described separatist structures being dissolved or reintegrated and realigned under the Presidential Council in Aden, alongside reinforcements and coordination. This was not peace in the south, but an attempt to stop fighting each other before the big round on the coast. Both sides therefore entered the September 2026 escalation in the west better prepared.
timeline.mapNote: The south is more aligned against the coastal front — still no decision.

timeline.title: September 2026: the Red Sea coast, and the present
timeline.summary: In September 2026 the Houthis broke back onto the west coast, took the port city of Mocha and closed on the Bab al-Mandab strait, while fighting continued in western Taiz and Lahj and mass displacement spread from the coast.
timeline.detail: After years of relative stalemate since the 2022 truce, a broad round of fighting opened on the Red Sea coast. Houthi forces advanced south and captured Mocha, a port city in south-western Yemen, then reported further progress towards Bab al-Mandab and a presence on sensitive islands including Mayun and Hanish, though some of those reports remain disputed or only partly verified. Control of the coast and of the approaches to the strait affects international shipping and the government's ability to hold the country's south-west. Government forces and tribal allies counter-attacked around Al-Wazi'iyah in western Taiz, near Hays and in Lahj, and tried to halt the advance. Pressure continued around Marib, the energy stronghold in the east, alongside fire and launches tied to Saudi Arabia and to the sea. UN agencies reported tens and then hundreds of thousands displaced from the west coast. The coast and the strait are the heart of the current round.
timeline.mapNote: The west coast, Bab al-Mandab, Taiz, Lahj and Marib.

fronts.name: Bab al-Mandab and the south-west coast
fronts.where: The Bab al-Mandab strait in south-western Yemen, between the Red Sea and the Arabian Sea
fronts.plain: Ships pass here between the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean. Mayun and Hanish are in Houthi hands; the high ground facing them in Lahj, on the Kahbub heights, is an open battle.
fronts.summary: A fourth consecutive day of fighting for the Kahbub heights in Lahj, which overlook the strait. Arab News, citing a government official, says the Houthis made no gains. The islands and the coast facing the strait remain in Houthi hands according to reporting from mid-September.
fronts.detail: Houthi forces hold Mocha, Dhubab, Mayun and Hanish according to reporting from 11 and 12 September. Fighting continues on the Kahbub heights, at Madaribah and Al-Arah: Xinhua reported high ground changing hands and more than 40 killed on 17 September, citing sources on both sides, while Arab News on 18 September quoted a government official saying the militia had not advanced by a centimetre. There is no verified change of control in the strait itself. UKMTO says the maritime threat remains focused on vessels with a Saudi connection.

fronts.name: Red Sea coast (Mocha to Dhubab)
fronts.where: The Red Sea coastal strip in south-western Yemen
fronts.plain: The corridor that connects the interior to the coast. Mocha's fall opened the road south towards the strait.
fronts.detail: The fall of Mocha on 10 September was the turning point of this round: from there the axis opened south to Dhubab and Mayun. Air strikes on supply routes between Al-Wazi'iyah and Mocha have been reported since, without the government claiming any re-entry into the port city.

fronts.name: Western Taiz and Al-Wazi'iyah
fronts.where: The districts between Taiz city and the Red Sea coast
fronts.plain: The fight here is over the corridor linking the interior to the coast. The ground is mixed — neither side holds all of it.
fronts.summary: The government army, via Al Jazeera on 18 September, repeats a claim of 30 Houthi fighters killed and 60 wounded in Al-Wazi'iyah in 24 hours, around the Al-Dharifah junction. It is a one-sided claim, with no verified change to the line.
fronts.detail: Local reporting describes an attack blocked at Al-Kadha and drones shot down, and three children killed at Al-Tarirah, with attribution disputed between sources. This is the connecting front: whoever holds it links or cuts Taiz city from the coast at Mocha.

fronts.name: Marib
fronts.where: Eastern Yemen — an oil and gas city
fronts.plain: The city and the main district are government-held. Houthi pressure comes from the west, with no change of control.
fronts.summary: Al Jazeera, 18 September: a claim of combined sniper and artillery fire against a crew and a 106mm gun in the west of the governorate — a one-sided claim. BBC Verify documented F-15 wreckage west of the city.

fronts.name: Al-Dhale
fronts.where: The southern highlands of Yemen, north-west of Aden
fronts.plain: Anadolu reported a Houthi drone shot down on the Murays front. No ground battle has changed control here.

fronts.name: Al-Jawf and Al-Hazm
fronts.where: North-eastern Yemen, close to the Saudi border
fronts.plain: The Houthis hold the governorate capital, Al-Hazm. Government forces are pressing from the desert through the Al-Lubanat camp, with no verified decision.
fronts.summary: Al-Araby, 16 September: government forces claim control of the desert half of the Al-Lubanat camp, while the hill section remains Houthi-held. Al-Hazm itself has not fallen.
fronts.detail: Control of the camp would open a corridor of about 50km to Al-Hazm, held by the Houthis since 2020. There is no independent confirmation that the governorate capital has fallen. This is a secondary front beside the Saudi border, running alongside the pressure on Marib.

recentDigests.title: Overnight 18-19 September: Riyadh, Azal, Syria
recentDigests.text: First air defence alerts in Riyadh and Al-Kharj, with explosions in Olaya. An explosion at a Houthi security compound in Azal killed four according to local sources, and Saree blamed Saudi Arabia without giving detail. Al-Akhbar reported that Syria turned down a Saudi request for fighters.

recentDigests.title: Evening of 18 September: Kahbub, ICG, UNHCR and WHO
recentDigests.text: Al Jazeera: a claimed attack blocked at Kahbub and a drone downed at Rajum. Crisis Group calls for a pause. UNHCR counts about 3,000 arrivals in Djibouti; WHO finds 60% of health facilities functioning. UKMTO reports no new attack on shipping today.

recentDigests.title: 18 September: Al-Sudayr, new artillery, IOM at 112,000
recentDigests.text: A claim of point-blank fighting at Al-Sudayr in Lahj; a government source describes the Jahannam and Al-Aqrab systems and a priority on Bab al-Mandab; the IOM counts at least 112,000 displaced and about 3,000 arrivals in Djibouti.

recentDigests.title: Overnight 14-15 September: western Marib, Al-Suwayda, Kahbub, IOM at 94,000
recentDigests.text: A claimed roadside bomb foiled west of Marib; missiles near the Al-Suwayda camp; entrenchment on the Kahbub heights; a Tihama force formed under Tareq Saleh; the IOM counts about 94,000 displaced.

situation.summary: Active war with no decisive outcome. Air defence alerts were sounded overnight in Riyadh and Al-Kharj for the first time, with explosions heard in Olaya. In Sanaa, an explosion hit a Houthi security compound in Azal, and Saree blamed Saudi Arabia without giving detail. Fighting continues in Taiz, Lahj and Marib.
